title: Connection info
error: Connection info is not available right now.

reason.good_one: No problems in the last minute
reason.good_other: No problems in the last {{count}} minutes
reason.network: Some voice from others was concealed: network loss
reason.cpu: Your audio processing is running late: high CPU load

sinceConnected: Counts since connected. Graphs: last {{minutes}} min.

help.dropouts: Gaps when your audio device could not keep up (overruns, underruns or restarts). Normal: 0.
help.late: Audio frames your computer handled too late, usually under high CPU load. Normal: 0 or close to it.
help.concealed: Voice frames from others that never arrived in time, so the client filled the gap. Caused by network loss. Normal: close to 0.
help.jitter: Delay added to even out voice packets from others that arrive unevenly. Normal: 20–60 ms.
help.processing: Time needed to process one 10 ms frame of your microphone audio. Normal: well below 10 ms.
help.realtime: Whether the audio threads get real-time priority from the system. On helps avoid dropouts under load.

recent.processingMax: Last {{minutes}} min: max {{value}} ms of the {{budget}} ms frame budget.

quick.title: Voice quality
quick.lowLatencyHint: Sends shorter packets for less delay. Uses more bandwidth.
quick.bandwidthHint: Low-latency mode (10 ms packets) would need about {{value}} kbit/s more for packet headers.
